title: Lapis
description: A full-stack blog application built with Vue 3 and a Node.js/Express backend. Users can register, authenticate, and create or manage posts through a responsive interface powered by Pinia state management and MongoDB.

title: Further
description: A horror, mystery, and thriller movie collection app built with Vue that focuses on organizing dark-themed films. The application features a clean interface for browsing movies and viewing structured film data.

title: Wanted Minds
description: A sleek, modern website for Wanted Minds, a fictional private detective agency operating in the heart of downtown Tokyo. This single-page React application showcases the agency's services, team members, and provides a contact interface.

title: CS50X 2025 Portfolio
description: A curated collection of problem sets and coding projects from Harvard's CS50 2025. This compilation demonstrates foundational programming skills, including C, Python, SQL, and web development with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript course.
